title: Estate Retirement Figures by Patron Class (Capital Credits)
content:
# Estate Retirement Figures by Patron Class

**Product:** Capital Credits (Patronage Capital). Figures for the early retirement of a deceased member's credits for the estate.

| Patron class | Estate retirement offered | Estate retirements paid at a discounted present value | Annual estate discount rate | Years after allocation at which an allocation would be retired in the general rotation | Days after board approval within which the estate check is issued | Largest gross amount retired for one estate in one calendar year | Joint membership retired for the estate only on the death of the last joint member |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential Patron Class | Yes | Yes | 5.75 percent | 22 | 30 calendar days | $25000.00 | Yes |
| Seasonal Patron Class | Yes | Yes | 5.75 percent | 22 | 30 calendar days | $25000.00 | Yes |
| Farm Patron Class | Yes | Yes | 5.75 percent | 22 | 30 calendar days | $25000.00 | Yes |
| General Service Patron Class | Yes | Yes | 5.75 percent | 22 | 30 calendar days | $25000.00 | Yes |
| Irrigation Patron Class | Yes | Yes | 5.75 percent | 22 | 30 calendar days | $25000.00 | Yes |
| Large Power Patron Class | No | Yes | 5.75 percent | 22 | 30 calendar days | $25000.00 | Yes |

## Reading the figures

- **Expected rotation years (22).** The number of years after its allocation year at which an allocation would be retired in the general rotation; it is used to count the years over which an early retirement is discounted.
- **Annual estate cap ($25000.00).** The largest gross amount retired for one estate in one calendar year; any remainder waits for the next calendar year.
- **Large Power Patron Class.** Estate retirement is not offered in this class, so its credits are not retired early for an estate; the other columns are shown for completeness of the schedule.

## Hypothetical illustration

An estate whose unretired credits in one class total $31000.00 has at most $25000.00 of gross retirement in one calendar year; the remaining $6000.00 waits for the next calendar year.
